biological_unit_and_age: Young versus aged donor PDLSCs; donor counts and age bands not stated in the PubMed abstract
design_and_reported_signal: Young periodontal-ligament-cell conditioned medium increased aged-PDLSC proliferation/differentiation; aged cells exposed to young conditioned medium formed cementum/PDL-like structures in the reported in-vivo differentiation model
best_use_for_next_assay: Positive benchmark for a donor-crossed niche-rescue experiment; require post-washout identity and attachment-function checks
main_limit: Conditioned medium is an undefined mixture; abstract omits donor counts/age bands; not an orthotopic tooth-socket, loaded attachment or tooth-position study

biological_unit_and_age: 90 impacted third molars from 54 systemically healthy donors aged 16-75 years, grouped into four age bands
design_and_reported_signal: Proliferative, migratory and differentiation capacity declined with age; no identified cementum/PDL-like tissue was reported in the two age groups included in the in-vivo transplantation comparison
best_use_for_next_assay: Use donor-level functional endpoints and ectopic tissue formation as separate measures; retain the negative graft outcome as a falsifier
main_limit: Teeth are not independent people; third-molar selection and ectopic transplantation do not model an orthotopic load-bearing socket

biological_unit_and_age: 62 third molars from 42 donors; where donors contributed multiple teeth, one randomly selected tooth was analyzed; age-defined donor groups
design_and_reported_signal: Older-donor PDLSC sheets had lower matrix-associated fibronectin, integrin-beta1 and COL-I, with lower osteogenic ALP, RUNX2 and OCN readouts
best_use_for_next_assay: Separate cell survival from matrix production and lineage output in the PDL-interface model
main_limit: Cell-sheet composition and osteogenic assays are not evidence of bilateral fiber insertion, physiological mechanics or stable tooth position

biological_unit_and_age: 18 independent donors in age groups <=20, 20-40 and >40 years
design_and_reported_signal: Older groups showed lower proliferation, migration and mesodermal differentiation; >40-year donors had shorter telomere length and lower SSEA4 than <=20-year donors; IL6 and CXCL8 expression was higher in adult groups
best_use_for_next_assay: Track donor age, cell identity and inflammatory alternatives together; do not treat stemness markers alone as rejuvenation
main_limit: Small grouped cohort; no donor-level expression matrix located; cell-culture assays do not establish restored tooth attachment

biological_unit_and_age: 20 young donors aged 19-20 and 21 adult donors aged 35-50 supplied cells; each experiment used three independent donors per group
design_and_reported_signal: Adult-donor PDLSCs showed lower proliferation and differentiation, higher apoptosis and weaker immunosuppression; the supplement is a group-level differential-expression workbook, not a donor-by-gene matrix
best_use_for_next_assay: Use donor as the replicate; independently validate any candidate because the reported screen used p<0.05 or fold change >2 and three qRT-PCR directions disagreed with the microarray
main_limit: Triplicates/wells are not independent donors; no multiple-testing correction is described for the microarray screen; RC3H1, TNFSF4 and TNFSF14 qRT-PCR directions disagreed with the microarray; no donor-resolved age atlas

biological_unit_and_age: Young healthy orthodontic patients aged 15-25 supplied human PDLSCs; murine jaw spatial-transcriptomics component
design_and_reported_signal: Experimental TGF-beta1 exposure induced ROS accumulation, PRKAG2 methylation/silencing and G2 arrest-associated senescence in cultured human PDLSCs; NAC or decitabine mitigated the induced phenotype
best_use_for_next_assay: Keep regenerative-cue and senescence readouts paired; use only as a separately qualified mechanistic challenge
main_limit: Young-cell perturbation model, not a natural-aging cohort or proof of aged human PDL rescue; no loaded orthotopic attachment endpoint

biological_unit_and_age: Mouse orthodontic spring-force model with human PDLSC cell assays; aged WT mouse periodontal injections also tested
design_and_reported_signal: BDNF reduced senescence-associated readouts and promoted osteogenic markers; in the orthodontic-force setting it promoted tooth movement
best_use_for_next_assay: Any anti-senescence or osteogenic candidate must be tested with position and no-force stability endpoints
main_limit: Force-driven tooth movement is not restoration to a registered original position; mouse intervention does not establish human tooth-position safety
